video.title: AI欧腐《心上人的狼王父亲夜夜独宠》
video.desc:
英文名太长了 放这 My Crush's Wolf King Father Seeks Pleasure with Me Every Night
一种直译羞耻感
Jacob White, a human youth bullied relentlessly at Hoss Academy, is framed by Owen, the young lord of the Bloodclaw family, and accidentally drawn into the world of the werewolf king Leon Black. The cold, domineering Leon discovers by chance that Jacob is his destined Luna, moving from possession and protection to deeply loving him. Yet Owen, consumed by jealousy and obsession, repeatedly colludes with outside enemies, framing Jacob and plotting against Leon, even staging a rebellion to seize power. Jacob grows through pain and betrayal, transforming from a human boy at everyone's mercy into a companion capable of standing beside the werewolf king. In the end, beneath the blood moon, the two shatter the conspiracy and complete an eternal covenant, becoming the destined lovers witnessed by the entire Bloodclaw family.

Jacob White 是一名在霍斯学院饱受欺凌的人类少年，他遭到血爪家族少主 Owen 的陷害，意外闯入了狼王 Leon Black 的世界。冷酷霸道的 Leon 偶然发现 Jacob 竟是自己的命定伴侣，从最初的占有与保护，渐渐变为深爱。然而 Owen 被嫉妒与执念吞噬，一次次勾结外敌，陷害 Jacob、算计 Leon，甚至发动叛乱夺权。Jacob 在痛苦与背叛中成长，从一个任人摆布的人类少年，蜕变为足以与狼王并肩而立的伴侣。最终，在血月之下，两人粉碎阴谋，缔结永恒的契约，成为整个血爪家族共同见证的命定恋人。
